notes.title: Demo 0.10.6 Update
notes.notes:
[p]We're currently developing an outdoor exploration and resource collection system, but it hasn't been implemented yet.[/p][p]Pixels make up 90% of the game's size, and we'll strive to reduce the file size without sacrificing image quality.[/p][p]Subsequent updates may experience lower or higher pixel quality due to these adjustments.

Update:[/p][list][*][p]Added some map details[/p][/*][*][p]Added footstep sounds for stepping on water[/p][/*][*][p]Added Sirius' shop-watching animation[/p][/*][*][p]Added effects and sounds for sinks[/p][/*][*][p]Added ESC function to close windows[/p][/*][*][p]Added required furniture for recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted walkable areas for lakes and rivers[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted alignment of roads with terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture and tools will now automatically populate the quick access slot (furniture placement will now include aiming functionality)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character sleeping animations, allowing players to wake them up in the middle of the night[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where characters would disappear when downstairs in a player's house[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced game size to 1.22G[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192906/2063dd750af95dd08964031ac70c585fe33b2083.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo 0.10.1 Update
notes.notes: [p]This update focuses on the rhythm game and the final event.[/p][p]The last update for this area was last year's Bloodstain 2.[/p][p][/p][p]Update:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the responsiveness of the rhythm game and invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added basic rhythm game sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased difficulty adjustment for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a basic tutorial for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects and special effects for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a health bar for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the continuous click gameplay for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the attack range determination for the rhythm game.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces flashing in the plot and dims the highlighted screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the invasion event could be exited.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the shop screen would freeze due to frequent opening and closing.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.10.0 Update
notes.notes: [p]We've finally fixed all the more serious issues and can move on to other development. [/p][p][/p][p]Update:[/p][list][*][p]Added a jump function[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 24-hour shop, eliminating the need to wait for NPCs to arrive[/p][/*][*][p]Added underwater camera visual effects (this was just a quick use, as the game doesn't plan on letting players go underwater)[/p][/*][*][p]Added two types of flowers[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the background music system[/p][/*][*][p]Revised the inventory and quick menu functionality (a future update will allow players to place furniture directly without entering the layout mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some scene issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where NPCs would move while browsing the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized loading times at game startup[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.9.20 Update
notes.notes: [p]Because some people are experiencing serious issues that are preventing them from playing,[/p][p]This update primarily addresses the bug reporting feature. This button can be found on the pause screen in the game.[/p][p]For the developer's protection, you must agree to this data collection statement. Please understand.[/p][p][/p][p]Update Content:[/p][list][*][p]Added bug reporting functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to interaction distances[/p][/*][*][p]Added a quick item slot at the bottom (not yet linked to the item slot)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the interaction distance for the cafe sign[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the story system dialog resetting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with background music switching being triggered by regular NPCs[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.9.19 Update
notes.notes: [p]Thanks again for your feedback. This update also addresses the bugs we've collected.[/p][p][/p][p]Update Content:[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to save and access game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the sense of slippage when moving players.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced camera vibration between stopping and moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the player's transition time between picking up and placing items.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the player's interaction range in the cafe game.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the distance between the follow type UI and edges.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the labels for interactable trees and rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the sound effect group settings for items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial to lock the system button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI for the Cafe mini-game, crafting table, and research upgrades to move to other areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objects to fade in and out incorrectly, obscuring the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objects to interact with other items during a long interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hand-held IK to behave incorrectly after a character sat down.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the time display to display incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the background music to change incorrectly quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Cafe test to end immediately after opening hours.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed drop protection to not transmit correctly.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.9.16 Update
notes.notes: [p]Thanks to everyone for your feedback and bug reports![/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a safeguard mechanism to prevent the player from falling out of the world[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced game size from 7.5GB to 2.1GB[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visual effects of the 2D tutorial guide[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing and misaligned text issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the camera dropped when the character stood on wall edges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a time freeze bug that occurred when replaying[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where item info cards would get stuck on the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the fire extinguisher would remain stuck in the character’s hand after closing the café[/p][/*][/list]
